response.text: {"label": "protocol_misunderstanding", "reason": "The sub never drives rxd to the idle-high level before the first start bit, so the receiver starts on the undriven line early (sub `3 44000 rx busy_rise 0`), samples the real start bit as data bit 0, and gets the byte shifted by one bit (sub `78 644000 rx hs 4a`, gold `79 795000 rx hs a5`)."}
